arguments.query: SELECT region_code, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT payment_status, count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok')), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) FROM orders o GROUP BY 1
SELECT i.*, p.list_price_twd, p.product_name FROM order_items i JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE order_id IN (1,2,3)
SELECT * FROM payments WHERE order_id IN (1,2,3)
SELECT quantity, count(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(DISTINCT o.order_id), sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE c.region_code='TW-C' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN payments p USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, count(*), count(s.shipment_id), count(s.delivered_ts) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1

SELECT sum(r.refund_amount_twd), sum(r.refund_ts>='2025-01-01' AND r.refund_ts<'2026-01-01'), count(*) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.region_code='TW-C' AND o.status=3 AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01'
